articleTitle: Why Ramping Up Marathon Training Can Make You Wired at Bedtime
imageHeadline: Training harder but can't fall asleep?
imageSubtext: Your nervous system may not be switching off after evening workouts
pinTitle: Why Marathon Training Ramps Can Disrupt Sleep (And What Helps)
pinDescription: Ramping up mileage quickly can leave you wired at bedtime — even when you're exhausted. It's a nervous-system response to increased training load, especially when workouts happen close to bedtime. Learn the timing shifts, recovery strategies, and wind-down cues that help your body downshift after hard training days.
